user.title: Connect to 50five
user.description: Enter the credentials of your 50five account (the same as in the 50five app).

card_config.title: Card Configuration (Optional)
card_config.description: Card used to start charging sessions from Home Assistant, e.g. NL-TNM-C12345-6. Leave blank to use the card linked to your charging station.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer accepted. Enter your current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EVC-net
reconfigure.description: Update your 50five account credentials. Leave password blank to keep the current password.

init.title: EVC-net Options
init.description: Charge card used to start sessions (leave blank to use the card linked to your charging station), and the number of channels to create per-channel entities for.
